description: RA-02 defense in depth for in-process role assumption. When a process runs with SYSTEM_ROLE (surface_runtime launches every surface with SYSTEM_ROLE=<surface id>; `pnpm surfaces` and `pnpm config-mission` set it for their own runtimes), withExecutionContext / withExecutionContextAsync may only assume the SYSTEM_ROLE itself, the shared core roles (narrow libs/core store-writer roles), or the roles listed for that system role here; anything else throws [ROLE_ASSUMPTION_DENIED]. A SYSTEM_ROLE without an entry may only assume itself. Processes without SYSTEM_ROLE are unaffected. Lists are backed by the call-level reachability report docs/developer/role-assumption-reachability.json (scripts/analyze_role_assumptions.ts, RN-02: call sites and role-forwarding wrappers walked from each entry point, including child processes that inherit SYSTEM_ROLE) and by opt-in runtime traces (KYBERION_ROLE_ASSUMPTION_TRACE, RN-01). A grant is only removed when the report proves it unreachable and no trace observed it; scripts/analyze_role_assumptions.contract.test.ts fails when a reachable role is missing. See knowledge/product/governance/AUTHORITY_MODEL.md section 3.B2.

shared_core_roles.rationale: Narrow roles that libs/core modules assume internally on behalf of every caller to write their own governed stores: infrastructure_sentinel (work coordination, peer messaging, mesh, the stimuli journal), knowledge_steward (mission creation), and the GovernedArtifactRole set of artifact-store / surface stores (chronos_gateway, slack_bridge, surface_runtime; surface-coordination-store maps a surface to its role from a governed plus a personal-tier map, so any GovernedArtifactRole is reachable wherever it is used). The broad roles (ecosystem_architect, mission_controller, sovereign_concierge) are never shared: each system role lists them only where docs/developer/role-assumption-reachability.json reaches them. The report shows oauth_callback_surface and surface_runtime do not reach some shared roles; they stay shared because removing a shared role for one system role needs a policy-shape change (tracked as a follow-up).

chronos_mirror_v2.rationale: Chronos viewer-scoped routes assume chronos_localadmin / chronos_operator (withViewerExecutionContext*, plugin-host-boot tenant registry reads); chronos_token_registry_reader: lib/viewer-context.ts and lib/api-guard.ts read the chronos-access viewer token registry (its only grant), plus libs/core authn-providers (registry-token provider); generation_scheduler: the schedule quick action runs libs/core generation-scheduler in-process. reconcile_config_fallbacks (added by RN-03): the same quick action loads the media-generation actuator in-process, whose capture action runs system-actuator pipeline ops including reconcile-ops (libs/core/reconcile-ops.ts); Chronos can already assume sovereign_concierge, so this adds no effective authority. ecosystem_architect, mission_controller, sovereign_concierge: reachable per docs/developer/role-assumption-reachability.json (e.g. mission_controller via libs/core agent-identity appendGoverned and approval-gate, ecosystem_architect via libs/core deployment-adapter / storage-janitor, sovereign_concierge via libs/core authn-providers / browser-onboarding / tool-runtime-policy, and the GovernedArtifactRole union of surface-coordination-store). The surface also has unresolved sites (child processes that inherit SYSTEM_ROLE with a computed entry point, computed dynamic imports), so the analysis treats every role as reachable and nothing here is removable. RN-01: the plugin-views E2E (surface-runtime mode) and the Chronos vitest suite under SYSTEM_ROLE=chronos_mirror_v2 observed chronos_gateway, chronos_localadmin, chronos_operator, chronos_token_registry_reader and mission_controller, all listed.

The surface also has unresolved sites (child processes that inherit SYSTEM_ROLE with a computed entry point, computed dynamic imports), so the analysis treats every role as reachable and nothing here is removable. chronos_token_registry_reader is deliberately absent: computer-surface/auth.ts passes `registrations: null` (TR-01), recorded as reviewed-infeasible in the report.

RN-03 removed ecosystem_architect and mission_controller: docs/developer/role-assumption-reachability.json proves neither reachable (no unresolved sites, no child processes that inherit SYSTEM_ROLE) and RN-01 traces (hermetic smoke of the built surface, oauth_callback_surface vitest suites under SYSTEM_ROLE) only observed surface_runtime (the surface's own callback write, a shared core role).

RN-01: the Presence Studio vitest suite and a hermetic smoke under SYSTEM_ROLE=presence_studio observed ecosystem_architect, mission_controller and sovereign_concierge. chronos_token_registry_reader is deliberately absent: presence-studio/security.ts passes `registrations: null` (TR-01), recorded as reviewed-infeasible in the report.
